run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run the migrate_imports script in dry run mode to preview import changes in a directory
run_migrate_imports_execute: run the migrate_imports script with --execute to apply import path replacements to Python and YAML files
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run the migrate_imports script on a single file to replace fairchem import paths
refactor_replace_strings_in_file: refactor the replace_strings_in_file function to support additional file extensions beyond YAML and Python
review_mapping: review the import path mapping dictionary to add or remove fairchem module migration entries
